jobs.title: Engineering Intern, Product Quality
jobs.location: Tempe, Arizona, United States of America
jobs.body: Work Flexibility: Onsite What You Get Out of the Internship ​​ At Stryker, we believe that developing the next generation of talent is just as important as developing life-changing medical technologies. As an intern, you won’t just observe — you’ll contribute to meaningful projects, gain exposure to leaders who will mentor you, and experience a culture of innovation and teamwork that is shaping the future of healthcare. As an intern, you will : ​ ​ Apply classroom knowledge and gain experience in a fast-paced and growing industry setting ​ Implement new ideas , be constantly challenged, and develop your skills ​ Network with key/high-level stakeholders and leaders of the business ​ Be a part of an innovative team and culture ​ Experience documenting complex processes and presenting them in a clear format Who we want ​​ Challengers. People who seek out the hard projects and work to find just the right solutions. ​ Teammates. Partners who listen to ideas, share thoughts and work together to move the business forward. ​ Charismatic networkers. Relationship-savvy people who intentionally make connections with both internal partners and external contacts. ​ Strategic thinkers. Interns who propose innovative ideas and consistently exceed their performance objectives . ​ Customer-oriented achievers. Individuals with an unparalleled work ethic and customer-focused attitude who bring value to their partnerships. ​ Game changers. Persistent interns who will stop at nothing to live out Stryker’s mission to make healthcare better. Opportunities Available ​ ​ As a Quality Engineering intern at Stryker, you will be placed in one of the following teams: Advanced Quality ​ AQE interns work on engineering projects related to development of new products. Areas of emphasis may include human factors engineering, risk management, application of statistics, reliability engineering, design verification, and design validation including customer interaction. As Homer Stryker pointed out, “If your tools don’t work, make them work. If you can’t make them work, make some that do work.” In this directive, the AQE team works to make sure that the products we develop at Stryker will work consistently for our customers to meet or exceed their expectations. ​ ​​ Process Quality ​ PQE interns collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product sustainment. When non-conforming issues arise in production, it is our responsibility to perform robust root cause analysis and implement effective corrective actions. Do you enjoy deep dive investigations and driving collaboration and communication to achieve issue resolution? If so, you may be a great fit for this team! PQE interns are focused on quality, compliance and continuous improvement. They use their education to work with a variety of tools including CAD for fixture design, root cause analysis methods, LabView, and validation activities to optimize production, inspection, and quality system processes. ​ ​ Supplier Quality ​ SQE interns are responsible for all things supplier-related . Stryker uses a number of critical suppliers to manufacture components and finished products, and to provide critical services. This team’s job is to work closely with the suppliers to ensure components and their manufacturing processes meet our required standards. Do you enjoy using your technical background and communication skills to influence suppliers? If so, you might be a great fit for this diverse and talented team! The role requires working closely with internal customers from multiple functions, meeting with suppliers frequently , and the use of both technical and business skills. ​ ​ Quality ​ Quality interns work with our internal cross-functional teams and external sales team and customers to ensure we develop and sustain a product with the highest quality. The team’s job is to ensure we develop the right products up front – evaluate risk, ensure our customer’s user needs are met, and help drive craftsmanship, safety, durability and reliability into the product. On the post-market side, they also work closely with regulatory to handle any complaints and implement design changes, as needed, to address quality issues. The role requires someone who has great communication, problem-solving, and technical skills. Majors Targeted: Mechanical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering , Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related majors . What You Need ​​ Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a related field; must remain enrolled in a degree-seeking program after the internship . ​ Cumulative 3.0 GPA or above ( verified at time of hire ) Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. and not require employment-based sponsorship now or in the future . ​ Strong written and verbal communication skills, with proven ability to collaborate and build relationships Demonstrated leadership, problem-solving, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and eagerness to learn in a dynamic environment . $ 20 min hourly wage – $3 5 max hourly wage, sign-on bonus, 11 paid holidays annually, and either paid corporate housing or a living stipend, dependent upon hiring location Travel Percentage: None Stryker Corporation is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. Stryker is an EO employer – M/F/Veteran/Disability. Stryker Corporation will not discharge or in any other manner discriminate against employees or applicants because they have inquired about, discussed, or disclosed their own pay or the pay of another employee or applicant. However, employees who have access to the compensation information of other employees or applicants as a part of their essential job functions cannot disclose the pay of other employees or applicants to individuals who do not otherwise have access to compensation information, unless the disclosure is (a) in response to a formal complaint or charge, (b) in furtherance of an investigation, proceeding, hearing, or action, including an investigation conducted by the employer, or (c) consistent with the contractor’s legal duty to furnish information.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineering Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.location: Shakopee, MN, United States of America
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. The Manufacturing Engineer Intern will provide technical support to the engineering team supporting manufacturing processes in the steel components plant. Processes supported may include machining, welding, grinding, stamping, sheet & tube laser cutting and forming. Technical support may also include tooling and fixture design for process quality improvements and new part support. Intern will report to engineering manager. What Will You Do? In order to grow and build a successful career with The Toro Company, you will be responsible for: Support safety projects and manufacturing processes as directed Maintain plant layout for machine moves and cost reduction efforts Evaluate manufacturing and material handling processes for new parts Support new part quoting activities & SAP routings Conduct time studies of part’s processes Assist quality engineering with print tolerances & process capability studies Assist in the research & development of capital projects & equipment Support Quality, Maintenance and Lean operations problem solving activities Support RPS and Kaizen events, 5S and 3S OAM activities Frequently report verbally and in writing on project status Other duties as assigned What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Pursuing a degree in Mechanical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering discipline Software: AutoCAD, SolidWorks, Creo Parametric, Microsoft suite- Excel, PowerPoint, CadCam: Mastercam, Esprit Demonstrated project experience (preferred) Strong mechanical aptitude Desire to learn new skills and maintain knowledge of new technologies Must be independent, self-motivated. Must have interpersonal skills in working with a variety of cross-functional teams What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $22–$28. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.location: Albuquerque, NM, United States of America
jobs.body: Worker Type Supplemental Job Description Systems Engineering Intern - Space Technologies Our paid Summer Internship Program is designed to provide students with an immersive, hands-on experience within the aerospace and defense industry. Interns work alongside AV team members on meaningful projects involving cutting-edge technology while developing professional relationships, strategic problem-solving skills, and practical experience in a full-time work environment. This is a 12-week, onsite program intended for highly motivated and passionate students who are currently enrolled in college or are recent graduates. Applicants must have a minimum 3.0 GPA, with a preference for students at the junior level or above. Our program has been recognized by Yello and WayUp as one of the Top 100 Internship Programs in the United States for multiple years. Depending on the team and location, students who are willing to relocate for their internship may be eligible for a relocation and housing reimbursement stipend. AV is seeking a Systems Engineering Intern to join our Space Technologies division for a full-time summer internship. The intern will support the development of advanced space systems, including space electronics, flight-control systems, sensors, electro-optical systems, and laser communications technologies. AV's highly selective internship program provides students with meaningful opportunities to contribute to real projects alongside experienced professionals. Interns gain hands-on exposure to advanced aerospace technologies, build strong professional relationships, and develop practical technical and problem-solving skills through close collaboration with AV team members. The program is also intended to develop future engineering talent and may provide opportunities for high-performing interns to pursue future full-time roles with AV. Position Summary In this role, the intern will gain practical experience supporting requirements analysis, system modeling, technical documentation, verification activities, and Systems Engineering process improvement. Assignments may include program support, documentation, data analysis, workflow automation, and other activities that support the Systems Engineering team. Position Responsibilities ·Support requirements analysis, organization, derivation, and traceability. ·Assist with system modeling and Model-Based Systems Engineering activities. ·Support the development and maintenance of technical documentation. ·Assist with verification and validation planning and tracking. ·Support the refinement, documentation, and improvement of Systems Engineering processes. ·Use tools such as Cameo, Microsoft Excel, Microsoft Word, Python, and other engineering or process tools as appropriate. ·Collaborate with Systems Engineering and other engineering disciplines. ·Participate in technical reviews and, as opportunities arise, laboratory, integration, and test activities. ·Perform other duties as assigned. Basic Qualifications ·Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Computer Science, Optical Engineering, or a related technical field. ·Strong analytical, organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills. ·Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment. ·Ability and willingness to learn new technical concepts, tools, and processes. ·Ability to work full-time during the summer internship period. ·Due to the nature of this position, U.S. citizenship is required. Preferred Qualifications ·Exposure to systems engineering, engineering design, system modeling, or requirements analysis through coursework, projects, or prior experience. Clearance Level No Clearance The salary range for this role is: AeroVironment considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to, the location, the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate’s work experience, education/training, and key skills. In order to comply with the requirements of the ITAR and/or the EAR, applicants must qualify as a U.S. person under the ITAR and the EAR, or a person to be approved for an export license by the governing agency whose technology comes under its jurisdiction. Please understand that any job offer that requires approval of an export license will be conditional on AeroVironment’s determination that it will be able to obtain an export license in a time frame consistent with AeroVironment’s business requirements. A “U.S. person” according to the ITAR definition is a U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident (green card holder), or protected individual such as a refugee or asylee. See 22 CFR § 120.15. Some positions will require current U.S. Citizenship due to contract requirements. Benefits : AV offers an excellent benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401K with company matching, a 9/80 work schedule and a paid holiday shutdown. For more information about our company benefit offerings please visit: http://www.avinc.com/myavbenefits . We also encourage you to review our company website at http://www.avinc.com to learn more about us. Principals only need apply. NO agencies please. About AV: AV isn’t for everyone. We hire the curious, the relentless, the mission-obsessed. The best of the best. We don’t just build defense technology—we redefine what’s possible. As the premier autonomous systems company in the U.S., AV delivers breakthrough capabilities across air, land, sea, space, and cyber. From AI-powered drones and loitering munitions to integrated autonomy and space resilience, our technologies shape the future of warfare and protect those who serve. Founded by legendary innovator Dr. Paul MacCready, AV has spent over 50 years pushing the boundaries of what unmanned systems can do. Our heritage includes seven platforms in the Smithsonian—but we’re not building history, we’re building what’s next. If you're ready to build technology that matters—with speed, scale, and purpose—there’s no better place to do it than AV. We are proud to be an EEO/AA Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability/veterans. AeroVironment, Inc. is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer and welcomes all qualified applicants. jobs.body: > At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. Completed coursework in Statistics, Mechanics of Materials, and/or Solid Modeling. A strong passion for engineering innovation and learning in a nuclear environment. jobs.title: Semiconductor Systems Automation Intern
jobs.location: Santa Rosa, California
jobs.body: Overview Keysight is a mission-critical design enablement partner for organizations solving the world’s most complex engineering challenges. With deep engineering expertise and leading design, emulation, and test solutions, our ~16,800 employees help customers in over 100 countries accelerate innovation across communications, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace and defense, semiconductor, and artificial intelligence markets. Learn more about what we do. At Keysight, people come together to explore new ideas, challenge what's possible, and advance the technologies defining the future. Here, you'll find opportunities to do your best work, take your career further, and thrive in an award-winning culture. Learn more about our benefits. Responsibilities As a Software Engineering Intern at Keysight’s High Frequency Technology Center, your primary focus will be developing software automation for CAD-related engineering workflows, including design review, CAD data generation, verification, and repeatable process checks. You will help build practical tools that reduce manual review effort, improve consistency across engineering handoffs, and make CAD workflow steps more traceable, reliable, and scalable. This work may include translating engineering rules and review criteria into automated checks, improving how CAD artifacts and related metadata are generated or validated, and supporting workflow documentation so that automation can be maintained and extended over time. In addition to the CAD automation focus, you will contribute to the definition, implementation, and documentation of data ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) workflows and data pipelines that organize engineering and manufacturing data for reliable downstream use. You may also support machine learning model definition and implementation, including data preparation, model workflow development, and evaluation of how these methods can be applied to real engineering and manufacturing problems. Throughout the internship, you will work closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to turn project needs into maintainable software solutions in a technical semiconductor environment. Preference will be given to candidates that can commit to a 6+ month internship, but shorter internships will also be considered. Qualifications Qualifications Currently enrolled in an accredited undergraduate or graduate program in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Electrical Engineering with a software focus, or a related technical field. Programming experience in Python, C#, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or a similar modern software development language. Interest or experience in workflow automation, CAD/EDA tooling, engineering software, data processing, or manufacturing systems. Experience with databases, SQL, ETL concepts, data pipelines, APIs, or structured data documentation is preferred. Exposure to machine learning concepts, model development, data preparation, or model evaluation is preferred. Candidates must have strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and collaboration skills for successful interaction with engineering, software, and manufacturing teams. Must be highly motivated, detail-oriented, and comfortable learning new tools and technical workflows in a fast-paced engineering environment. Keysight Internship Program Requirements Candidates who wish to be considered must be currently enrolled in an accredited college or university undergraduate or graduate program as of September 2027. Applicants who have graduated before the internship start date will not be considered unless they are starting a new undergraduate or graduate program after graduating. Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position. Candidates who now or at any point in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status (e.g., H-1B Visa status) may not be considered. For any individual who is not a U.S. person, Keysight may need authorization from the U.S. Department of State, U.S. Department of Commerce, or other appropriate federal agency before the individual can access export-controlled items. Employment in this position for non-U.S. persons is contingent on Keysight’s ability to obtain any required government authorizations. jobs.body: Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all . Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever. You will gain hands-on experience building full-stack applications, AI agents, automation solutions, and enterprise platforms while working with modern development tools, cloud technologies, and AI-enabled engineering practices. Previous related co-ops, internships , and / or work experience preferred . Ability to create basic packaging component drawings. Solid Works is preferred. Knowledge of packaging transportation test methods (ISTA or ASTM). Experience with basic data analysis and statistics to analysis part measurement data. Knowledge of CAPE PACK program is desirable. Strong PC skills, proficiency with MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Willing to travel domestically approximately 10% Leadership Profile: Proven leadership experience through student organizations, athletics, Greek life, community service, volunteer organizations, campus programs, military service, or other leadership roles. A track record of influencing others, leading initiatives, driving results, and creating positive impact within teams and organizations. Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity, adapt to changing priorities, and solve complex problems. Evidence of grit, resilience, and perseverance when facing challenges, setbacks, or competing priorities. Strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and an innovative mindset. Excellent interpersonal communication skills and emotional intelligence, with the ability to build relationships across diverse teams. Geographic mobility and flexibility required to pursue co-op and future career opportunities in locations aligned with business needs. Onsite and in-office work is an essential function of this role and is required throughout the program and in future placements to support collaboration across businesses, functions, and locations. To qualify, applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States and should not require sponsorship (current or future) for employment visa status. Thermo Fisher does not offer employment in this position to holders of F-1, J-1, H-1, OPT, and CPT Visas for the purpose of obtaining practical experience. This position may also be eligible to receive a variable annual bonus based on company, team, and/or individual performance results in accordance with company policy. jobs.title: Technical Innovation Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: Columbus, OH, United States
jobs.body: POSITION SUMMARY The Technical Innovation Intern will support the Office of the CTO by researching and evaluating emerging technologies that can enhance data center operations and Vertiv’s current and future product offerings. This role is ideal for candidates passionate about innovation and the future of critical digital infrastructure. The intern will also contribute to hands-on AI development and experimentation using local AI computing systems while collaborating with engineering, product, IT, university, and innovation teams. RESPONSIBILITIES • Conduct research on emerging data center technologies, including AC power, air and liquid cooling, energy storage, IoT, advanced materials, AI infrastructure, and digital twins. • Analyze industry reports, academic publications, patents, and market trends to identify innovations applicable to Vertiv’s product lines. • Evaluate technologies from startups, universities, established vendors, and advanced technology providers. • Assess the potential impact of emerging technologies on current and future product offerings. • Prepare technical summaries, reports, presentations, innovation briefs, and recommendations highlighting integration or development opportunities. • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to assess technical feasibility and application potential. • Use local AI computing systems to prototype, test, and document AI and machine-learning workflows. • Support local large language model deployment, inference, evaluation, prompt testing, semantic search, and lightweight fine-tuning experiments. • Assist with Python-based data pipelines, API and RSS integrations, model evaluation, dashboards, and automation workflows. • Help maintain reliable AI computing workloads, including logging, scheduled jobs, backups, startup and recovery processes, and technical documentation. • Follow Vertiv IT, laboratory, access-control, cybersecurity, and responsible-AI requirements when working with AI systems and company information. • Support university partnerships, startup engagement, innovation dashboards, newsletters, and knowledge-management activities. • Present research findings, demonstrations, and recommendations to the Office of the CTO and engineering leadership. QUALIFICATIONS • Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Physics, or a related field. • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. • Demonstrated work ethic, attention to detail, and commitment to high-quality work. • Strong analytical, research, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills. • Ability to learn in a fast-paced innovation environment and manage multiple assignments. • Strong collaboration and teamwork skills across engineering, product, IT, and external partner teams. • Experience with Python and familiarity with Linux or Ubuntu environments is preferred. • Familiarity with machine learning, generative AI, large language models, embeddings, semantic search, or model evaluation is preferred. • Exposure to Git or GitLab, REST APIs, databases, containers, automation, or open-source AI tools is a plus. • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint; Power BI or Streamlit experience is a plus. • Ability to troubleshoot software and system issues and maintain clear technical documentation. • Commitment to safe, secure, ethical, and responsible use of AI systems and company information. PHYSICAL & ENVIRONMENTAL DEMANDS • No special physical requirements. • Work may take place in an office or controlled lab environment using desktop AI-computing equipment. TRAVEL REQUIRED • None or minimal travel as required #LI-RB1

jobs.body: WD is building the infrastructure behind the AI-driven data economy. As AI scales, so does data. Every interaction, every model, every system generates data that must be stored, managed, and made accessible over time. That’s where we come in. We combine deep engineering expertise with global-scale manufacturing to deliver the storage systems that make AI possible, powering hyperscale data centers, cloud platforms, and enterprise infrastructure worldwide. As a Read/Write Channel Integration Engineer, you will work with industry leading Hard Disk Drive (HDD) technology, evaluating new channel features, performing failure analysis, and developing scripts and tools to test an advanced digital signal processing chip, used for data recording and readback. jobs.body: An internship at onsemi offers a dynamic opportunity to gain hands-on experience through real-world projects that drive innovation in the semiconductor industry. Interns are entrusted with meaningful responsibilities and exposed to cutting-edge technologies, fostering both technical skill development and professional growth. onsemi views internships as a strategic pipeline for entry-level career positions, providing a collaborative and inclusive environment where interns work alongside diverse teams and contribute to high-impact initiatives. The company’s commitment to sustainability, including its goal of achieving net-zero emissions by 2040, enables interns to engage in projects that align with global environmental priorities. Key benefits include: Competitive compensation and medical benefits Flexible work hours aligned with academic schedules Access to Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) which foster a sense of belonging and provide opportunities for mentorship and community engagement Networking events, professional development workshops, and project showcases that build career readiness and visibility across the organization Internship roles span multiple disciplines including engineering, business operations, data analytics, and finance, and are designed to align with onsemi’s strategic goals of innovation and workforce development. Structured programs such as rotational field sales and finance analyst tracks offer additional career pathways for interns transitioning into full-time roles. onsemi is seeking a graduate-level Device Characterization Intern in San Jose to support next-generation semiconductor technology development. In this role, the intern will perform hands-on wafer-level measurements, automate test and reporting workflows, analyze characterization data, and work with devices across image sensor, ASIC, high-voltage, analog mixed-signal, and low-voltage integrated circuit technologies. This internship is intended for a graduate student who wants to combine hands-on wafer-level characterization, test automation, and data-driven analysis. The intern will work with engineering teams in San Jose to characterize devices, automate measurement and reporting workflows, and contribute to AI-enabled approaches for improving characterization efficiency. · Carry out wafer-level measurements on test structures using semiconductor parameter analyzers, capacitance meters, and source measurement units · Perform flicker noise measurements using noise characterization instruments · Testing ESD (electrostatic discharge) devices using TLP (transmission line pulse) testers · Generating test reports and summaries · Automate test report generation, summary creation, and recurring characterization data workflows. · Participate in AI-related initiatives that improve device characterization workflows, data analysis, or test automation. Qualifications – External Requirements: · Understand semiconductor device physics and circuit operation. · Have experience doing measurements with lab equipment like IV meters, power supplies, and oscilloscopes. · Experience with Python, Visual Basic, C or LabVIEW. · Be a quick learner who can work efficiently both independently and as part of a team. · Excellent verbal and written communication skills. · Nice-to-have qualifications include: o Have experience with semiconductor characterization equipment like semiconductor parametric analyzers, capacitance meters, and source measurement units. o Be familiar with programming test instruments with GPIB. o Have experience with machine learning, AI, and developer-assistance tools such as GitHub Copilot. o Have experience using AI frameworks or similar tools to develop practical engineering solutions. To be considered for an internship, you must be currently enrolled in a degree seeking program. This position is specifically looking for someone who will be enrolled in a Bachelors degree program in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Physics, or Systems Engineering in the US. Here at onsemi we take great pride in our internship program and the efforts we take to provide students with hands-on industry experience. We provide competitive pay medical benefits, various networking event opportunities, and flexible hours based on school schedule. onsemi is excited to share the base salary range for this position is $33.35/hr. The final pay rate for the successful candidate will depend on geographic location, skills, education, experience, and/or consideration of internal equity of our current team members. We also offer a competitive benefits package. https://www.onsemi.com/site/pdf/Benefits-Summary-USA.pdf

jobs.body: Company Overview At Bloom Energy, our vision for a world powered by clean, reliable, and affordable energy is more than just a dream—we’re making it a reality. For over two decades, we’ve been at the forefront of the global energy transition, pioneering solutions that empower critical industries to thrive in a rapidly digitizing, energy-intensive world. From revolutionizing power for AI-driven data centers to ensuring resilience for hospitals, electric grids, manufacturing facilities, and utilities, our solid oxide fuel cell (SOFC) and solid oxide electrolyzer (SOEC) technologies are redefining what’s possible by delivering energy abundance for all. With more than 30,000 fuel cell modules deployed worldwide, we are the trusted partner for Fortune 100 companies and innovators alike. Our cutting-edge solutions enable unparalleled “time-to-power” capabilities, reliability, and sustainability, ensuring our customers remain ahead in a world where soaring energy demand and intensifying energy scarcity are rapidly becoming the new norm. At Bloom, we thrive on collaboration, bold thinking, and relentless innovation. We believe that, together, we can create a brighter, more sustainable future while tackling the most pressing challenges of the 21st century. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Engineering and Tech Internship
jobs.location: Centennial, CO
jobs.body: Most engineering internships teach you how products are built. At Boom, you help build them. Boom Supersonic is building Overture, the world's fastest airliner, and Superpower, an industrial gas turbine built on the same core technology that advances our supersonic engine program. We believe the best engineering internships don't happen on the sidelines. They happen where real engineering is getting done. This is not a traditional internship. You won't sit quietly in meetings, take notes, or shadow from the sidelines. As a Boom intern, you will be embedded directly within core teams, tackling real, high-stakes engineering problems. Working alongside best-in-class engineers, you'll take on more responsibility and ownership than anywhere else in the industry. You’ll leave knowing your work actively pushed history forward. Who you are This program isn't for everyone. You are built for Boom if: You have a track record of building: You've built real hardware independently, led a competitive design team, or executed high-impact work during past roles that most engineers don't touch for years. You crave ownership, not hand-holding: You get uncomfortable waiting for answers and prefer diving headfirst into complex, ambiguous problems. You thrive under high stakes: When a problem gets harder, your drive goes up, not down. You're drawn to execution: The shop floor, lab, or test stand sounds significantly more exciting to you than a conference room. Select your discipline When applying, select the discipline below that best matches your background and passion: Materials & Manufacturing Processes: You'll work on the materials and processes that go into Superpower, Boom's gas turbine engine. That means hands-on involvement in material selection, process development, lab categorization and coupon-to-part testing for the high-performance alloys that make an engine possible. Own the whole process from ingot to forged disks and single crystal castings. Ideal Candidate: Solid fundamentals in material science of metallics and ceramics, with knowledge of the strengthening mechanisms of nickel superalloys and the thermal processing of ceramics both as coatings and molds. Hands-on experience in an M&P lab to test, categorize and evaluate high performance materials including creep and LCF testing and metallography of superalloys. Exposure to and experience running the machines for advanced processes including printing nickel superalloys and fabricating ceramics to support investment casting. Manufacturing: You'll support the production processes turning Superpower's designs into real hardware. That means hands-on work across engine assembly, machining, tooling, and process development as the program builds toward production. You won't observe – you'll own a piece of it. Ideal Candidate: Hands-on manufacturing experience – time in a machine shop, on an assembly line, or building real hardware. This is required, not a nice-to-have. Familiarity with machining processes, tooling, work instructions, or quality control in a production or R&D environment. Genuine curiosity about how complex hardware comes together – and how to make it come together better, faster, and more reliably. Electrical or Embedded Controls: You'll help design, build, and validate the electrical or control systems that bring Superpower to life. That includes instrumentation, controls, wiring architecture, and test systems that generate the data needed to develop Superpower. Your work will connect hardware, software, and test, turning ideas into reliable systems. Ideal Candidate: Experience designing, integrating, or testing electrical systems, whether through internships, research, Formula SAE, personal projects, or industry experience. Familiarity with electrical design, controls, instrumentation, embedded systems, or hardware integration. Someone who enjoys debugging complex systems and is energized by seeing hardware come to life. Mechanical: You'll help define how Superpower comes together. This team is responsible for translating requirements into an integrated system, balancing performance, reliability, manufacturability, and testability while partnering closely with propulsion, electrical, and manufacturing engineers throughout the development process. You'll work across design, analysis, manufacturing, and test to solve real engineering problems as the engine evolves from concept to hardware. Ideal Candidate: Experience designing, analyzing, or building mechanical hardware through industry, research, internships, Formula SAE, or personal projects. Familiarity with CAD, mechanical design principles, manufacturing processes, or structural analysis. Genuine curiosity about how complex hardware works and the drive to iterate until it works better. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex technical challenges and make thoughtful engineering tradeoffs. Excited by working across disciplines to solve first-of-their-kind engineering challenges with a highly collaborative team. Turbomachinery: You'll help design the actual core engine within both Superpower, Boom's gas turbine for AI power generation and Symphony, our Mach 1.7 medium bypass turbofan. This team is responsible for the design, performance modeling, and detailed analysis of the engine, with work spanning thermodynamic cycle analysis, aerodynamics & aeromechanics, internal cooling flow, mechanical & structural component design, combustion, and testing. Ideal Candidate: Experience with propulsion, turbomachinery, thermodynamics, fluids, combustion, or heat transfer through coursework, research, internships, or industry. Strong analytical skills with the ability to connect theory to real hardware and experimental data. Excited by not just using state-of-the-art analysis tools, but by creating their own; scripting together multi-disciplinary workflows that bring capabilities once only available to large teams to a single user’s fingertips. Software: You'll build the software that makes Boom's engineers faster. That means embedding directly with the teams designing, building, and testing Superpower - on the shop floor watching a part get made, at the test stand when data comes in - and shipping tools that remove whatever is slowing them down. Your code goes into daily use the same week you write it, and the people using it sit next to you. Ideal Candidate: Experience building real software people actually used - personal projects with users, open source contributions, hackathon wins, or production code from prior internships or research. Strong fundamentals in at least one serious language, and fluency with modern AI development tools. More excited to write code standing next to the machine it controls than alone in a cubicle - you want to see the part come off the line faster because of what you shipped. Special Projects: You'll join Boom's team of universal problem-solvers — the group we point at whatever is most broken, most urgent, or most important, anywhere in the company. Instead of going deep in one business function, you'll own a real piece of a high-stakes, cross-functional problem: driving a critical project that's slipping back on track, building the analysis behind a major decision, standing up a business process that outlasts your summer, or getting to ground truth on an operation that isn't working. You won't build the engine — you'll help make sure the company building it runs. You'll own the fix, not a recommendation. Ideal Candidate: Strong analytical horsepower — fast in a spreadsheet, and able to turn messy data into a clear answer. A track record of solving or leading something real — a competition team you drove, research or a role that stretched you well past your experience level. Equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and on a shop floor — you'd rather get to ground truth in person than wait for a report. Energized by ambiguity and ownership: when a problem gets harder and no one is handing you the answer, your drive goes up, not down. Work Location Internships require 100% onsite at Boom's headquarters located at 6803 S Tucson Way, Centennial, CO 80112. Internship Duration Internships will run for 12 weeks with flexibility to accommodate for the academic semester. What is it REALLY like to work at Boom? Find out here . Compensation The hourly pay rate for this position is $35 per hour for Hardware, $40 per hour for Software. Boom will also provide a housing allowance of $2,000. Additional perks include on-site meals and gym access. ITAR Requirement To conform to U.S. Government aerospace technology export regulations (ITAR and EAR), applicant must be a U.S. citizen, lawful permanent resident of the U.S., protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3), or eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State. Due to the nature of this position, candidates must be eligible to access export-controlled information and technology as required by applicable U.S. export control laws. Learn more about ITAR here. Boom is an equal opportunity employer, including for individuals with disabilities and protected veterans. We are building a culture of merit and excellence. Want to build a faster future? Come join Boom.

jobs.body: Job Title: Manufacturing Engineering Co-Op Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. jobs.location: Greater Chicago Area, United States of America
jobs.body: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview About Motorola Solutions At Motorola Solutions, our mission is simple: Solving for safer. We build and connect technologies that help protect people, property, and places across the globe. Our solutions foster the collaboration critical for safer communities, schools, hospitals, and businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. The Team: Systems Integration (Elgin, IL) Our Supply Chain organization is a fast-paced, dynamic environment delivering world-class communications solutions. You will be joining the Systems Integration team at the Elgin Experience Center—the critical bridge where customer needs and technological solutions converge. Here, our engineering team: - Stages systems with technology innovations which give Motorola Solutions a competitive edge in quality, speed, and delivery. - Hosts hundreds of customers annually to finalize and test designs for mission-critical emergency call-handling solutions. - Partners with field teams to deploy infrastructure that directly supports first responders and private enterprises. Job Description The Role As an Engineering Intern, you will work in a people-first culture focused on expanding human potential. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build, integrate, and stage complex infrastructure ecosystems. We look for innovative thinkers who are driven, accountable, and passionate about solving hands-on technical problems. Key Responsibilities Infrastructure Deployment: Execute the system staging process to build, image, deploy, and maintain robust infrastructure footprints. Virtualization & OS: Provision and support VMware vSphere and Red Hat KVM virtualization environments; construct and manage unified Microsoft Windows Server architectures, Active Directory, and Linux operating systems. Network & Security: Build, connect, and troubleshoot Cisco networking equipment (switches and routers); deploy enterprise Fortinet firewall solutions to optimize defense, traffic separation, and information flows. Communications Tech: Integrate analog, digital, and SIP-based audio processing technologies to support real-time critical communication feeds. Root-Cause Analysis: Analyze system behaviors and isolate performance anomalies across multi-vendor hardware, software, virtualization, and networking stacks. Project Ownership: Complete a dedicated summer continuous-improvement project, owning all aspects from ideation to execution and presenting your findings to leadership . Preferred Skills AI & Tech Fluency: Familiarity with generative AI tools for coding efficiency, data analysis, or process automation. Data-Driven Mindset: Experience with data analysis and statistical concepts to identify trends, interpret data, and drive continuous improvements. Communication & Collaboration: Strong ability to explain complex technical issues or methodologies clearly to cross-functional, non-technical stakeholders. Structured Problem-Solving: Ability to approach technical challenges logically, prioritize tasks effectively, and drive results in a team setting. jobs.title: Internship – EUV CSCM UIR
jobs.location: Hillsboro, OR, USA, United States of America
jobs.body: Introduction ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon. Customer Supply Chain Management (CSCM) UIR is the supply chain organization supporting EUV Upgrades, Installations and Relocations at customer sites across US. The team helps prepare and execute scheduled customer events by coordinating material requirements, monitoring material availability, addressing supply constraints, and supporting the flow of parts and tools needed for project execution. The team works closely with Customer Support and other supply chain partners throughout the event. Your assignment The CSCM Intern will support the EUV UIR Customer Supply Chain team through a defined supply chain improvement assignment focused on material availability, planning, and operational process effectiveness. The intern will analyze supply chain data and current processes, identify gaps and improvement opportunities, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to develop practical recommendations. The assignment will provide hands-on exposure to customer supply chain operations, data-driven problem solving, material planning, and process improvement. The intern will be expected to translate findings into clear recommendations and present the outcome of the assignment to the team. Specific projects will be tailored to match the education/experience level of the intern as well as the interns learning objectives for the summer. Interns will typically be required to document and present their findings as well as making an end of summer presentation to the group about what they achieved during their internship. Past projects have included: Identifying and documenting goals and targets (KPIs). Evaluating current processes and updating documentation to adhere to continuous improvement methodologies (LEAN/6 Sigma). Creating data visualizations to identify potential opportunities for automation (Power BI/ Copilot). Collaborating with CSCM colleagues from other areas to identify Best Known Methods (BKMs). Participating in projects to improve performance of material flow. Your profile Education and experience Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Analytics, Logistics, or a related field. Interest in supply chain, material planning, data analysis, and process improvement. Experience using Microsoft Excel to organize and analyze data; experience gained through coursework, academic projects, or previous internships is acceptable. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to work with data and translate findings into practical recommendations. Good written and verbal communication skills and an interest in working with cross-functional teams. Experience or interest in using AI-enabled productivity tools, such as Microsoft Copilot, to support data analysis, research, problem solving, and effective communication. Ability to apply new digital tools and AI thoughtfully to improve efficiency and generate insights. Skills Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems. To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills: Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work. Can learn and apply new information or skills. Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents. Strong customer focus and commitment to customer satisfaction through prioritization, quality, efficiency and professionalism. Ability to complete assignments with attention to detail and high degree of accuracy. Proven ability to perform effectively in a demanding environment with changing workloads and deadlines. Result driven-demonstrate ownership and accountability. Identifies bottlenecks and drives improvements. Work independently or as part of a team and follow through on assignments with minimal supervision. Demonstrate open, clear, concise and professional communication. Ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with manager, co-workers and customer. Work according to a strict set of procedures within the provided timelines. Other information Routinely required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach, and stretch. Occasionally required to move around the campus. Occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. You must be work authorized in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. Our headquarters in Beverly, MA , is located directly off Route 128 and just 10 minutes from the Beverly Train Station for those using public transportation. jobs.body: Job Title: Lab Automation & AI Engineering Co-Op Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Billerica, MA is seeking a Lab Automation & AI Engineering Co-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration. This is a hands-on opportunity to apply coding and AI skills to real laboratory challenges — helping automate manual workflows, streamline data handling, and prototype AI-assisted tools that improve lab efficiency and data quality. You will work alongside lab managers, scientists, and analysts to understand real lab processes and build practical, reliable tools that make everyday lab work faster and more consistent. This is a great fit for a student who enjoys working at the intersection of science, data, and automation. What You’ll Do: Support automation of manual lab workflows such as data processing, QC review, and report generation. Develop and test Python scripts or tools for data analysis, cleanup, and automation. Help prototype and evaluate AI-assisted tools (e.g., large language models, AI agents) for practical lab applications. Assist with connecting instrument data to lab systems (e.g., LIMS) and reducing manual Excel/CSV handling. Document workflows, assumptions, and usage instructions for tools you help build. Collaborate with lab staff to gather requirements and improve tools based on feedback. What We Seek: Currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field. Coding ability in Python (or similar) for data analysis or automation. Familiarity with structured data (Excel, CSV, databases). Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and eagerness to learn lab workflows. Ability to work onsite in Billerica, MA for the full Spring term. Exposure to AI tools, large language models, or AI agent frameworks. Interest in or coursework related to laboratory operations, analytical chemistry, or QA. Experience with APIs, data pipelines, or workflow automation. Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical users. Desired Major(s) & Graduation Year: Bachelor's or Master's in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or a related field Graduate in Spring 2027 or Spring 2028 Eligibility: Must be a currently enrolled student Available to work 40 hours a week, M-F (8a-5p) beginning in January through June Must be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co-op program Entegris is not currently hiring candidates for co-ops/internships who will need, now or at any time in the future, Entegris sponsorship through the H1-B lottery. jobs.body: Summer Internship May 24, 2027 - August 13, 2027 Morrisville, NC - 100% onsite Our System and Solutions team is looking for a talented electrical engineering or computer engineering student to join our team this Summer as an applications engineer intern. The successful candidate will work directly with their mentor and the team manager during their internship. jobs.title: Supplier Quality Intern - Summer 2027
jobs.location: Lincolnshire, IL, us
jobs.body: HydraForce, a Bosch Rexroth company, offers one of the most comprehensive lines of high-quality hydraulic cartridge valves for the mobile and industrial equipment markets. We design and manufacture high performance valves that meet virtually any need encountered in machine design. HydraForce cartridge valves are designed to fit a wide range of industry-common valve cavities. Our employees enjoy a fast-paced and challenging work environment that provides them with daily opportunities to Power Forward their careers. Through interaction with our global network of employees and customers, our employees provide products and solutions that have a global impact. For almost 35 years, HydraForce has been producing the most innovative electro-hydraulic control solutions for the mobile machinery and industrial equipment markets. Throughout the world, you can find our products in a broad range of applications: Agricultural and Turf Care Machinery Construction and Road-Building Equipment Material Handling and Personnel-Lift Equipment Transmission, Engine and Powertrain Controls Forestry and Resource Management Equipment Refuse and Waste Handling Equipment Injection Molding and Press Machinery Other Specialized Mobile and Industrial Applications The goal of HydraForce’s internship program is to develop future engineering resources for our organization while providing support to our Supplier Quality Engineering team. We structure the engineering internship to allow candidates the opportunity to develop knowledge and skill-sets unique to our industry. Project tasks reflect an increasing level of technical complexity based on demonstrated proficiency and success on prior assignments. Although there is no guarantee of employment, it is our goal to have our interns fully capable of stepping into an entry-level engineering position upon graduation. Supporting Job Elements: Create Value Stream Maps and then create projects to lean out process Clean, merge and analyze data from multiple data sources Create databases to house past and future data Use tools and techniques from Six Sigma, Lean, to analyze and solve problems Assist in continuous improvement projects Day to day support activities but not limited to inspection, sorting, problem investigations, and PPAP approvals Assist in non-conforming material reports and analysis Create and modify existing systems that track our metrics Create, improve on documentation such as control plans, FMEAs, WI, and process flows Qualifications: Advanced Excel skills; Power Bi, Minitab Committed to an engineering college undergraduate program Completed a minimum of 24 hours at the university level Coursework and/or experience in setting up databases, SPC, data collection Coursework and/or experience in statistical analysis, lean tools Coursework and/or experience in measurement systems Basic experience in 3D modeling; Understanding of GD&T Working knowledge of problem solving techniques and FMEAs Great written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills Majors Desired: Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering Internship Dates: June 2, 2027-August 6, 2027 The US base hourly range for this position will be in between $20- $27 depending on the credits accumulated for the undergraduate students. Your Recruiter can share more details about the specific hourly range during the interview process. Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization unavailable. By choice, we are committed to a diverse workforce and are an equal opportunity employer. jobs.title: Systems Engineering Intern Summer 2027
jobs.location: Chantilly, VA
jobs.body: ABOUT ROCKET LAB Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us. As a Systems Engineering Intern based at Rocket Lab’s site in Chantilly, Virginia, you will have the opportunity to support subsystem/system development testing and verification. This Systems Engineering team helps develop and execute to the technical baseline across all programs. WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor and other employees within the department to apply your knowledge and grow your skills both technically and professionally Work with a fast-paced group of professionals to apply engineering and industry concepts to solve real challenges Attend frequent 1:1’s with mentors and supervisors to facilitate success and learning while providing progress updates Enjoy tech talks and network with other interns and employees through social and professional events YOU’LL BRING THESE QUALIFICATIONS Ideal candidates will thrive in ambiguity and are excited to work in small, high-performing teams that are focused on continued learning and growth. Success in this position will be measured by the knowledge and experience you bring to the role, your ability to lead development projects without supervision, and your ability to successfully collaborate across teams to deliver results. Must be enrolled in a bachelor’s, master's or doctorate degree program in an engineering, physics or math discipline and have at least one semester of school remaining post internship GPA of 3.0 or above 3+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE GPA of 3.5 or above 6+ months of applied engineering experience (internship, laboratory, and personal/team project experience is applicable) Familiarity with optics Solidworks experience Cameo experience JAMA experience Proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel) ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS Able to work full-time, on-site for a minimum of 12 consecutive weeks beginning May or June 2027 COMPENSATION AND OTHER BENEFITS Pay Rate: $25.00 USD Hourly You may be eligible for a stipend to subsidize relocation costs WHAT TO EXPECT We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way. Important information: FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN US OFFICES ONLY: To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. Learn more about ITAR here . Rocket Lab provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment at Rocket Lab, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for the application/interview process for a job in the United States should contact Giulia Johnson at g.biow@rocketlabusa.com. This dedicated resource is intended solely to assist job seekers with disabilities whose disability prevents them from being able to apply/interview. Only messages left for this purpose will be considered. A response to your request may take up to two business days. FOR CANDIDATES SEEKING TO WORK IN NEW ZEALAND OFFICES ONLY: For security reasons, background checks will be undertaken prior to any employment offers being made to an applicant. These checks will include nationality checks as it is a requirement of this position that you be eligible to access equipment and data regulated by the United States' International Traffic in Arms Regulations. jobs.location: Chelmsford, Massachusetts, United States, United States of America; East Setauket, New York, United States
jobs.body: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description The Commercial Engineering Intern (Independent Cart Technology) will support Rockwell Automation's Independent Cart Technology (ICT) Commercial Engineering team in developing customer solutions, testing and validating system configurations, creating technical documentation, and supporting product demonstrations and training activities. You will have hands-on exposure to advanced linear transport technologies including iTRAK®, MagneMover®, and related motion control platforms used in manufacturing and automation applications. jobs.location: USA Wilmington,  MA - HQ, United States of America
jobs.body: Who we are With its A.I.-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high-density, end-to-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. Timeframe: Summer (May-Aug 2027) At Symbotic, Early Career talent plays a meaningful role in helping us reimagine the future of supply chain automation. Through our Internship and Co-op programs, students have the opportunity to contribute to real projects, collaborate with experienced engineers and business leaders, and gain hands-on exposure to the technologies powering our end-to-end robotics and automation solutions. We are looking for curious, motivated students who are excited to solve complex problems, bring new perspectives to cross-functional teams, and see their work make an impact in a fast-moving, innovative environment. Along the way, Interns and Co-ops are supported through mentorship, professional development, networking opportunities, and a robust calendar of events designed to help them build community and grow their careers. Symbotic offers transportation and housing benefits for students who meet our relocation requirements. Continue reading below to learn more about this exciting opportunity! About the Opportunities Symbotic’s Industrial Controls team designs, implements, tests, and supports the control systems that power our automated warehouse equipment. Intern opportunities in our Industrial Controls function include: PLC interns contribute to the design and implementation of PLC hardware and software systems, troubleshoot system issues with site operators, develop and execute testing plans, participate in code reviews, and support commissioning and site installation. Electrical Engineering interns support electrical design for fixed automation equipment, including adapter cells, lift cells, motors, wiring, power, and variable frequency drives (VFDs). Software Tools interns support software tools used for data generation, structure validation, bot playback simulation, and data rendering for commissioning, testing, and system integration engineers. What You’ll Do: Assist one of our Industrial Controls teams with the design, implementation, testing, and support of controls technologies for automated warehouse systems. Contribute to the design and implementation of PLC hardware and software systems. Work with site operators and engineering teams to understand and diagnose PLC system issues. Develop and execute testing plans to validate PLC system performance. Participate in code reviews and adhere to PLC programming best practices. Support electrical design and troubleshooting involving circuits, motors, wiring, power distribution, and variable frequency drives (VFDs). Assist with site installation, commissioning, implementation, and support activities for automated equipment. Collaborate with commissioning, testing, system integration, software, and electrical engineering teams. Depending on team placement, contribute to software tools for data generation, structure validation, bot playback simulation, and data rendering. What you’ll need Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in engineering required (Electrical, Controls, Automation, Mechatronics, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related engineering/technical field). Familiarity with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), controls, industrial automation, or electro-mechanical systems. Ability to read or trace electrical circuits and an interest in motors, wiring, power systems, and VFDs. Familiarity with object-oriented programming and a programming language such as C# a plus. Exposure to AutoCAD, source control such as Git, software testing frameworks, or CI/CD pipelines a plus. Experience with technologies such as Jenkins, Redis, Docker, or Kubernetes a plus for software tools opportunities. Strong analytical, creative problem solving, critical thinking, and organizational skills. Outstanding communication skills with demonstrated ability to organize and present data. Our Environment Up to 10% of travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client and other customer locations. The employee is responsible for owning a credit card and managing expenses personally to be reimbursed on a bi-weekly basis. #LI-JK2 #LI-Onsite About Symbotic Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end-to-end, AI-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food & beverage companies. Applying next-gen technology, high-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com . We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $32.00 - $44.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.
