jobs.location: Ho Chi Minh, vn
jobs.body: The Bosch Group is a leading global supplier of technology and services. Since the beginning of 2013, its operations have been divided into four business sectors: Automotive Technology, Industrial Technology, Consumer Goods, and Energy and Building Technology. The Bosch Group comprises Robert Bosch GmbH and its roughly 360 subsidiaries and regional companies in some 50 countries. If its sales and service partners are included, then Bosch is represented in roughly 150 countries. This worldwide development, manufacturing, and sales network is the foundation for further growth. Bosch Global Software Technologies Company Limited (BGSV) i s 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH - one of the world’s leading global suppliers of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT, and Business Solutions. Starting its operation from 2010 at Etown 2 in HCMC, BGSV is the first software development center of Bosch in Southeast Asia. BGSV nowadays have over 4,000 associates, with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe, and the Asia Pacific region. With our unique ability to offer end-to-end solutions that connect sensors, software, and services, we enable businesses to move from the traditional to digital or improve businesses by introducing a digital element in their products and processes. The Occupant Safety Systems (OSS) team at Bosch is responsible for developing and producing Airbag ECUs used in millions of vehicles worldwide. We combine engineering excellence and automation expertise to improve safety and efficiency in airbag development. We are looking for a passionate intern to support our Calibration Automation and AI Tool Calibration Tool. You will work at the intersection of software automation engineering, AI/ML, and calibration engineering. Key Responsibilities 1. Automation Tool Development Develop and enhance Python-based tools to support calibration workflow (data processing, batch automation, reporting, visualization, etc.). Maintain existing calibration utilities (GUI tools, batch job tools, file parsers). Implement process improvements to reduce manual process Make documentation, user guides, and best practices for tool usage. 2. Tool Maintenance & Enhancement (Boosting Model) You will directly support the existing AI Calibration Quality Tool, which uses a Boosting-based ML model to detect abnormal airbag sensor signals Maintain and update the Python AI tool used for signal anomaly detection. Improve feature extraction logic for sensor and crash signals. Analyze false positives/false negatives and propose model refinements. Retrain the Boosting model with new datasets under engineer supervision. Implement automatic reporting of detected anomalies for calibration engineers. Integrate the AI module with existing calibration automation tools. Ensure tool stability, accuracy, and performance. 3. Calibration Engineering Support Process and prepare crash test data from vehicle/lab tests. Undergraduate students in Computer Science, IT, Electrical/Automotive Engineering, or related field. Strong Python, C\C++ programming skills. Official university recommendation letter with stamp (mandatory) Commitment: full-time or at least 4 days/week, duration 6 months Basic knowledge of: Machine Learning fundamentals Signal processing concepts Data structures & algorithms Logical thinking, curiosity, and willingness to learn automotive systems. Good English communication and teamwork skills. Nice to Have Experience with Boosting models (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost). Familiarity with sensor data, time-series, or anomaly detection. Basic understanding of MATLAB/Simulink. GUI development experience (Tkinter, PyQt, PySimpleGUI). Experience with data automation / scripting / tool development. Knowledge of vehicle dynamics or physics. Monthly Internship allowance + Meal & Parking allowance 1 day of paid leave per month Good benefits of Trade Union activities, team building and company trip. Opportunity to work in global projects of fast developing company and being a part of innovation team contributing initiative ideas to the hi-tech world. Engage in our diverse training programs which surely help strengthen both your personal and professional skills

jobs.body: > Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? You will gain hands-on experience in a dynamic environment while supporting key initiatives that directly impact efficiency and business growth. Data Integrity: Support the compliance team in auditing transaction data provided by the warehouse to ensure accuracy before official customs submission. Logistics/Trade Knowledge: Previous coursework or exposure to Supply Chain, Logistics, or International Business/Trade concepts. Technical/Data Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Excel (e.g., VLOOKUPs, pivot tables) or exposure to systems like SAPor similar . jobs.body: Axiom Space is a human space exploration company, building era-defining space infrastructure and delivering technology-driven solutions that will empower civilization to transcend Earth. jobs.body: > Nuclear Fuel Services (NFS) is a division of BWX Technologies. At BWX Technologies, Inc. (NYSE: BWXT), we are People Strong, Innovation Driven. jobs.body: Job Title: Materials Engineering Co-Op Job Description: Here at Entegris, we use advanced science to enable technologies that transform the world, and we are seeking employees who have the drive to continue the mission. The Role: Our site in Chaska, MN is seeking a Materials Engineering Co-Op to join our team for the Spring 2027 season. This assignment is intended to be 6 months in duration. The Advanced Purity Solutions, Materials Engineering Team is seeking a creative and innovative individual to help accelerate the development of next generation materials to meet the needs of leading semiconductor technology developers. This role of Materials Engineering Co-op reports to the Materials Engineering Senior Manager. AI, loT, Automation, and Digitization are fueling growth in the semiconductor industry. This is creating opportunities at Entegris as we develop leading-edge polymeric materials to meet these technology demands. Join our team and apply your expertise and leadership to be a part of creating materials to solve complex customer challenges. What You’ll Do: Lead polymer development projects involving cross-functional teams (engineering, manufacturing, product management, sales, marketing, and global supply management) Use your expertise to create materials solutions based on customer-defined product and application needs Develop qualification plans and success criteria for a given application Provide support to engineering and other departments(manufacturing, processing, incoming quality, etc.) on new and existing materials issues Investigate materials failures to determine root cause and work with cross functional teams to recommend corrective actions Document work via data packages and material specifications What We Seek: Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Materials / Chemical / Polymer Engineering Experience/exposure with formulation and development of polymeric compounds Analytical background with working knowledge of chemical and polymer analysis laboratory instrumentation and methodologies Knowledge of polymer manufacturing and processing including injection molding, rotomolding, blow molding, and extrusion Experience using structured DOE and statistical methods in an R&D environment Understanding of Root Cause and Corrective Action processes and tools Experience in a global R&D environment is preferred Desired Major(s) & Graduation Year: Pursuing a Bachelor's Degree in Materials / Chemical / Polymer Engineering Target Graduation Date of December 2027 or May 2028 Eligibility: Must be a currently enrolled student Available to work 40 hours a week, M-F (8a-5p) beginning in January through June Must be familiar with the university’s requirements to participate in a co-op program Entegris is not currently hiring candidates for co-ops/internships who will need, now or at any time in the future, Entegris sponsorship through the H1-B lottery. WHY WORK AT ENTEGRIS? Lead. Inspire. Innovate. Define Your Future. Not everyone who works for a global company shares the same background, experiences and perspectives. We leverage the differences of our employees to bring new ideas to the table. Every employee throughout the company is encouraged to share input on projects and initiatives. Our decision-making process is truly a collaborative effort as we realize there are leaders at every level of the organization. We put our values at the core of how we operate as an organization — not just when it’s convenient, but in a lasting and meaningful way. We want the time and energy you spend here to have a positive impact on your life inside and outside of the office. WHAT WE OFFER Our total rewards package goes above and beyond just a paycheck. Whether you’re looking to build your career, improve your health, or protect your wealth, we offer generous benefits to help you achieve your goals. Compensation: $20-$30/hour range with actual pay dependent on candidate overall skills for the role Values-driven culture with colleagues that rally around People, Accountability, Creativity and Excellence Entegris does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role. Do not apply for this role if you will need Entegris immigration sponsorship (e.g., H1B, TN, STEM OPT, etc.) now or in the future. At Entegris we are committed to providing equal opportunity to all employees and applicants. Our policy is to recruit, hire, train, and reward employees for their individual abilities, achievements, and experience without regard to race, color, religion, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, marital or military status.

jobs.title: Undergraduate Engineering Intern - Innovation
jobs.location: Rochester, MN, United States
jobs.body: This undergraduate internship is a full-time position Summer-Fall 2027 (May or June through December) on site in Rochester, Minnesota. Some interns have been able to maintain an on-line evening college course, but accepting this position requires the intern to not pursue any significant coursework for the summer or fall of 2027. The Division of Engineering is looking for an intern to assist our innovation project teams providing technical services to clinicians innovating to improve Mayo Clinic’s research and clinical practice. The primary purpose of the Engineering Internship is to provide students with relevant engineering experiences. The position offers a wide range of job responsibilities, including: assisting innovation engineers in interviewing clinician innovators to determine the technical services they need, determining clinical and human factors needs to determine project requirements, observing surgery and clinical procedures, partnering with engineers and technical staff to translate requirements into design strategy and a development plan, participate in brainstorming, and drafting product documentation (technical writing). The ideal candidate will have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal; have strong technical writing skills and be able to author technical documents; work independently; understand the project development process; have proficiency in Microsoft applications such as Office, SharePoint, Teams, and Excel to manage data and create reports; be working toward a technical engineering degree; and have a desire to learn about medical device development. The candidate will be introduced to the processes and documentation requirements of medical device development; gain experience conducting clinician interviews to elicit needs and requirements, participate in engineering innovation sprint sessions, brainstorming, design consultation, and internal and externally outsourced proof of concept device fabrication projects. Mentors will be assigned to provide instruction, guidance and to assess performance. The intern is responsible for learning the procedures and processes of the Engineering team. The intern will be given work assignments to reinforce the learning experience and to provide benefit to the work unit as well as provided an opportunity to present their work accomplishments in an end of term presentation. The intern will be responsible for completing all internship-related assignments and reports for both Mayo Clinic and the participating educational facility (if applicable). The incumbent must be enrolled in a mechanical or biomedical engineering degree program from an accredited college or university and have completed a minimum of four semesters – or the equivalent – of instruction toward their Bachelors degree. To be considered for this position please attach the following to your application: 3.3 GPA requirement or higher undergraduate transcript Resume or CV Applicants are strongly encouraged to include a Cover Letter

jobs.title: Internship in the field of Lean Manufacturing
jobs.location: Tienen, Vlaams Gewest, be
jobs.body: Robert Bosch Produktie N.V., located in Tienen, Belgium, is within the Bosch Group the lead plant and worldwide center of competence for development, engineering and manufacturing of wiper arms. Customers are both original equipment automotive car manufactures and aftermarket customers. As part of the Bosch strategy, we offer students the opportunity to participate in an internship at our location. Safety, Cost efficiency and quality are our main focus points, and to maintain the excellent position we are at, we strive for: continuous improvement of our equipment efficiency, proactive work on process understanding and root cause analysis, introduction of new process and process automatisation to reduce manufacturing cost and introduction of new products to improve customer satisfaction. If you look for a position where you can take initiative, learn and bring added value in an industrial environment, you’re the student we are looking for. The internship will ideally last 3-6 months and can be either full-time or part-time (let us know your availability, and we’ll work something out). At present, you can work remotely. Depending on your study program the internship may contain the following main points: Support the design of new production machines and processes. Participation in Bosch Production System projects: continuous improvement work on existing production and/or logistic processes the fields of Safety, Quality, Cost & Delivery. Standardization and improvement of production and/or logistics processes. Definition & implementation of lean standards: value stream planning, standardized work, pull production, leveling, quick changeover, … I4.0 and digitalization. Preferred start date:February - March You must be enrolled as a student. Language: good knowledge of English is required. German and possibly Dutch is a plus. Fields of study: mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, production engineering, technical business economics. Completed basic study period. Good knowledge of MS-Office. You are able to communicate efficient & effective, you can work on your own and as a team player. Responsible, independent and reliable worker. Intercultural interest and understanding. An internship will be successful if you are inquisitive, active and ask for work. The main condition is that you are a European citizen and if not, you can only do an internship through a European exchange program. The internship requires that you have the nationality of a EU-country or that you are taking part in the Erasmus program. The personal experience of the interns is usually the following: The company employs 10-15 interns all year round from various countries. Therefore this is also a great opportunity to enhance your social and language skills. The interns live mostly in Tienen or in Leuven, known as a multicultural university city. You receive 800 € as expense reimbursement per month.

jobs.title: Functional Structural Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: Lone Tree, CO, United States of America
jobs.body: Come start your career with some of the brightest and most innovative minds in the country! As a Technical Intern, you will participate in a comprehensive summer internship program designed to provide hands-on experience in a dynamic aerospace and defense environment. You will work alongside industry experts, contribute to real-world projects, and develop valuable technical and professional skills. This internship offers a unique opportunity for growth through mentoring, cross-functional workshops, and direct involvement in company projects. The ISR (Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance), Aviation, and Security (IAS) business area is a leader in ISR and aviation, it is a leading prime manned and unmanned aircraft systems integrator for innovative, high-performance ISR and aviation systems. Its end-to-end Command, Control, Computers, Communications and Intelligence, Surveillance & Reconnaissance (C4ISR) capabilities encompass design, integration, test, certification, ground/flight training and complete logistics support. IAS tailors solutions to customer cost, performance, and schedule requirements and designs to consistently exceed expectations – with an unrivaled record of on time and on (or under) budget deliveries. Responsibilities: Participate in actual technical projects and contribute to team objectives by completing assigned tasks. Receive guidance and mentorship from experienced industry professionals in your field. Prepare and maintain technical documentation, reports, and records as required. Assist in collecting, analyzing, and interpreting technical data to support engineering decisions. Attend planning meetings to understand project requirements, timelines, and team goals. Perform hands-on technical work assignments to gain practical experience and build technical skills. Work closely with team members, absorb and learn from their expertise, and apply that learning to ongoing projects. Identify opportunities for process improvements and support the implementation of best practices. Participate in workshops designed to provide a deeper understanding of the business and company culture. Strong skills in Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Visio. Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment. Strong organization skills and work ethic; detail oriented. jobs.body: We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions. We’re looking for people who put their innovation to work to advance our success – and their own. Join an organization that ensures a more secure world through connecting and protecting our customers with inventive electrical solutions. Early Careers at nVent Innovation, inclusion, and growth. By joining nVent, you have the opportunity to help build a more sustainable and electrified world, to be celebrated for bringing your authentic self to work and bring forward bold ideas that drive your personal and professional growth. Our culture of positive energy, integrity and respect will be the fuel you need to launch a purposeful, exciting career. Dream big, expect development and plug into our growing, global community where your diverse skills and talents will be deployed to make a difference in todays electrified world. This is a 12-week full-time internship during summer 2027. In this position, you will get to: Monitors daily production of various value streams and participating corrective actions Conducts quality inspections utilizing quality tools Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing data; making recommendations Learn and support the application of Lean Methodologies and Principles to become a Lean change agent Execute and coordinate employee training to ensure that procedures are followed and meet all quality requirements. Coordinate the timely and accurate movement of material into, within and out of assigned work area as needed. Internship Details Interns are paid $22 per hour Interns are responsible for transportation to and from work Relocation and housing support is available for eligible candidates Interns and Co-ops receive paid time off, paid sick time, paid volunteer time, and paid holidays Interns who demonstrate outstanding performance may be offered a subsequent internship or full-time offer of employment with nVent Location : The Operations Internship is based out of our facility in Anoka, MN. What You Will Experience in this Position: Your experience as an intern goes beyond the day-to-day of your role. In addition to the support of your manager, you can expect to grow and develop through exposure to leadership, engaging in development opportunities, and networking with other early career professionals. Training & Development: Training and development is provided throughout your internship through on-the-job experiences and structured learning opportunities, fostering the development of business acumen and leadership skills at a global organization. Community : Join a community of other early career professionals as you launch your career. A peer-led committee helps to organize social, professional and service-related activities and events for interns and early career professionals. You will also be invited to join our Employee Resource Groups (ERG’s) which offer special events, networking, professional development and volunteer opportunities throughout the year to promote inclusion and respect and to help us embrace our diversity. Mentorship & Networking: Build a network of peers, managers and senior leaders to support your career path and aid your growth. Gain exposure to nVent professionals at every level who will act as formal and informal mentors during your internship. Current Junior, Graduating with an undergraduate degree between December 2027 and June 2028. Must be authorized to work in the U.S now and in the future. nVent does not offer sponsorship to candidates. Strong verbal and written communications skills Excellent attention to detail and organization skills Willingness to learn and to work collaboratively with all levels within the organization. Ability to respond and adapt to feedback in a positive manner. Energy to listen, desire to learn and ability to be resilient and adaptable through change Strong work ethic and personal responsibility to see things through to completion Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint Demonstrated leadership experience WE HAVE: A dynamic global reach with diverse operations around the world that will stretch your abilities, provide plentiful career opportunities, and allow you to make an impact every day nVent is a leading global provider of electrical connection and protection solutions. We believe our inventive electrical solutions enable safer systems and ensure a more secure world. We design, manufacture, market, install and service high performance products and solutions that connect and protect some of the world's most sensitive equipment, buildings and critical processes. We offer a comprehensive range of systems protection and electrical connections solutions across industry-leading brands that are recognized globally for quality, reliability and innovation. Our principal office is in London and our management office in the United States is in Minneapolis. Our robust portfolio of leading electrical product brands dates back more than 100 years and includes nVent CADDY, ERICO, HOFFMAN, ILSCO, SCHROFF and TRACHTE. Learn more at www.nvent.com . Commitment to strengthen communities where our employees live and work We encourage and support the philanthropic activities of our employees worldwide Through our nVent in Action matching program, we provide funds to nonprofit and educational organizations where our employees volunteer or donate money Core values that shape our culture and drive us to deliver the best for our employees and our customers. We’re known for being: Innovative & adaptable Dedicated to absolute integrity Focused on the customer first Respectful and team oriented Optimistic and energizing Accountable for performance Benefits to support the lives of our employees Benefit Overview At nVent, we value our people and their health and well-being. We provide a broad benefits package with meaningful programs for eligible full-time employees that includes: Medical, dental, and vision plans along with flexible spending accounts, short-term and long-term disability benefits, critical illness, accident insurance and life insurance. A 401(k) retirement plan and an employee stock purchase plan — both include a company match. Other supplemental benefits may include tuition reimbursement, caregiver, personal and parental leave, back-up care services, paid time off including volunteer time, a well-being program, and/or legal & identity theft protection. At nVent, we connect and protect our customers with inventive electrical solutions. People are our most valuable asset. Inclusion and diversity means that we celebrate and encourage each other’s authenticity because we understand that uniqueness sparks growth.

jobs.title: Growth Internship (Summer 2027)
jobs.location: El Segundo, CA
jobs.body: There was a time when all of America believed that the future of the physical world could be radically different. The engineers of the mid-1900s put a man on the moon in eight years, designed and built planes and submarines from scratch in under three, and conceived of building things we wouldn’t even be able to dream up today. Today, the last of the engineers who imagined and built these systems are retiring. As they go, we lose not only the engineering knowledge gained from their decades of imagination and trial-and-error, but also the spirit that made that imagination possible. Amca is working day-in and day-out to restore America’s ability to engineer anything that our critical systems depend on, and reinvigorate the cycle of creation that allows imagination to shape physical reality. We rapidly develop and manufacture new critical components and subsystems required to build and sustain the planes, military vehicles, and core infrastructure America needs. By restoring the capability of our antiquated supply chains, we increase the country’s capacity to imagine and realize new systems, and make a physical world that looks very different from today. Overview Growth at Amca takes on all 0-to-1 projects. These projects are broadly split into two categories. Special Projects is largely focused on new business initiatives and internal operations. It requires deep intellectual creativity, research rigor, and the ability to communicate complex ideas. Brand is largely focused on resonating an idea with a specific audience (e.g. talent, acquisitions, government). It requires deep creativity, intense empathy, and the ability to articulate aesthetic taste. Everyone on growth is extremely analytical, persuasive, moves quickly, and is unwilling to ever take no as an answer. You are probably a great fit if you're currently a serious humanities student. Hourly Pay Range $30 — $50 USD This position requires use of information which is subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR). All applicants must be U.S. persons within the meaning of ITAR. ITAR defines a US person as: any individual who is granted U.S. citizenship; or. any individual who is granted U.S. permanent residence ("Green Card" holder); or. any individual who is granted status as a "protected person" under 8 U.S.C 1324b(a)(3). Amca, Inc prohibits discrimination or harassment based on the following categories: race, color, religion, religious creed (including religious dress and grooming practices), national origin, ancestry, citizenship, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), genetic information, marital status, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender, gender identity, gender expression, age (40 years and over), sexual orientation, veteran and/or military status, protected medical leaves (requesting or approved for leave under the Family and Medical Leave Act or the California Family Rights Act), domestic violence victim status, political affiliation, and any other status protected by state or federal law.

jobs.title: Field Service Representative Intern
jobs.location: Germantown, MD, United States of America
jobs.body: Worker Type Supplemental Job Description Summary Field Service Representative Intern AV is seeking dedicated, customer-focused RF Technology Field Service Representative (FSR) interns to join our team. In this role, you will support system testing at AV facilities and travel to customer locations to install, maintain, troubleshoot, and support advanced RF technology systems used in mission-critical applications. As an FSR, you will play an essential role in ensuring the operational readiness and reliability of systems that directly support national security. You will apply your technical expertise in the field while developing strong relationships with engineers, customers, end users, and internal stakeholders. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical knowledge, hands-on experience across multiple disciplines, and exceptional attention to detail. You are skilled at diagnosing and resolving complex problems; communicating effectively with program managers, engineers, and customers; and working independently in dynamic, high-pressure environments. This position is well suited for someone who enjoys hands-on work, solving challenging technical issues, building lasting customer relationships, and delivering innovative solutions in support of critical missions. Position Responsibilities ·Install and Set Up Systems: Travel to customer locations to install RF technology systems, ensuring they are properly set up and operational. ·Perform Maintenance and Repairs: Conduct routine maintenance checks and troubleshoot issues to keep systems running efficiently. jobs.body: We make what matters work. You want to make an impact in the world. At Eaton, we’re solving some of the toughest challenges on the planet. Our Early Career Programs open up an exciting world of opportunities for you to make a difference on a global scale. Your assignments are more than tasks and busy work; they're your chance to drive innovation in intelligent power management and shape the future of our company. You'll team up with seasoned leaders, gaining diverse experiences that'll drive you forward to define and reach your career goals. What sets our Early Career Programs apart: Personalized Program Experience: We’re committed to energizing your career and empowering your impact. No two participants share the same experience or set of responsibilities. Broad Exposure: Diverse work locations and comprehensive customer portfolios are a required part of the adventure, enhancing your learning and maximizing exposure. Role Exploration: Gain insight into various careers within Eaton through extensive services that ensure safe, efficient, and reliable power systems at every stage. Strategic Networking: Benefit from networking and mentorship opportunities within one of North America's largest and most experienced power distribution service organizations. Tangible Learning: See firsthand how Eaton is powering the future of Power Distribution through real world application and customer service. In a Switchgear Modernization role, you’ll build hands-on technical expertise by testing, troubleshooting, analyzing, and improving real-world power systems while collaborating with engineers, manufacturing teams, and customers to solve complex electrical challenges. It’s time to make connections, get energized, and power ahead. Eaton provides a competitive total rewards package commensurate with applicable skills, knowledge, and experience and consistent with internal and external market practices. The hourly salary for this role ranges from $20.77 - $25.96 per hour. What you’ll do: Position Overview: The Electrical Engineering Services and Systems global service team is one of the largest and most experienced teams of power system professionals in the industry. As one of our engineers, you’ll help to provide solutions to our customers’ power problems at every stage of the power system. The Switchgear Modernization Engineer Internship is designed to provide opportunities to interns who demonstrate the same high level of ethics, values, creativity and performance we expect from our employees. During the summer paid internship, participants will work on projects that have a measurable impact on our business and will be coached and mentored by leaders within the division. Eaton’s switchgear modernization offers cost-effective renovation to existing equipment, with minimal power interruptions and without total replacement. Our solutions extend the useful life of aging electrical power systems by providing safe and reliable reconditioning of existing equipment, as well as new replacement circuit breakers and other components that improve reliability and safety in existing power systems. In this internship, you will: Test and Troubleshoot: Use a wide range of electrical, electronic, and mechanical tools and equipment to test products and ensure they meet customer specifications. Documentation and Analysis: Prepare and verify technical CAD drawings, schematics, bill of materials and layouts; analyze nonstandard equipment for manufacturability. Problem Solving: Diagnose and resolve issues independently or with engineering support; maintain accurate test records. Collaboration and Support: Work closely with manufacturing teams and customers. This internship will help prepare you for both technical and future leadership roles at Eaton. As an intern, you will be provided with a structured training and development curriculum; a blend of instructor-led, virtual classrooms, eLearning courses, and on-the-job training provided by expert mentors and team members to assist you in developing your career. Qualifications: Required (Basic) Qualifications: Actively enrolled or received a degree in a bachelor’s or master’s program with a focus in engineering from an accredited institution Minimum overall cumulative GPA of 2.8 Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. Working knowledge of test equipment and diagnostic instruments for automation and power management systems. Knowledge of troubleshooting, test and repair techniques. Performs physically demanding tasks, requirement to stand, walk, stoop, squat, kneel, and reach above, to, and below shoulder level, lift, carry, push, pull, and use hands to handle and feel. Frequently required to climb and regularly required to lift/carry/push/pull up to 50 pounds; occasionally required to push/pull greater than 50 pounds with assistance. May be required to drive extended distances, work in extreme weather and temperature conditions, work at sites with areas that have poor lighting, ventilation, and dust and/or be exposed to high noise levels. This role may include up to 25% travel within a local region. Successfully complete and maintain compliance with Eaton’s safety program and policy; This includes role-applicable portions of the EESS Qualified Electrical Worker (QEW) program and any required annual re-certifications thereafter. jobs.title: Embedded Engineer - Summer 2027 Intern (US Person Required)
jobs.location: United States
jobs.body: Honeywell Technologies: Build What Matters At Honeywell Technologies, you can work on technology that helps make the world safer, smarter, and more efficient. We are a global automation company focused on helping customers run critical operations safely, reliably, and efficiently, with about $17B in 2025 sales, 54,000 employees, roughly 600 sites, and headquarters in Charlotte, NC. Work on practical innovation. Honeywell Technologies is moving from automation toward autonomy by combining AI, controls, connected data, and domain expertise to help assets work harder, people work smarter, and processes run more efficiently. Grow with purpose. At Honeywell Technologies, you can grow your career and network by contributing to the company’s success. Join a customer obsessed culture built on respect, collaboration, diverse perspectives, continuous learning, individual well-being, and celebrating achievement. Be part of a culture that values people. Our people are at the heart of what we do, with an emphasis on impact, representing Honeywell with pride, bringing diverse perspectives, and solving problems with curiosity and resilience. Shape the future by making what matters better. ABOUT THE ROLE: At Honeywell Technologies, the Embedded Engineer develops and implements the software of embedded devices and systems. They are also responsible for the analysis and monitoring of the efficiency and stability of a system. They develop and implement embedded devices and systems and support software quality assurance while optimizing I/O performance. The Embedded Software Engineer develops codes, tests, and troubleshoots system software. They are the designers of the first layer of code that runs on a device and need a full comprehension of its hardware. Location: This position is available in multiple locations across the United States. The exact worksite location will be selected based on business requirements and the candidate’s relevant experience and qualifications. The hourly base range for this position is $24.00/hr - $45.00/hr . Please note that this salary information serves as a general guideline. Honeywell considers various factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate's work experience, education and training, key skills, as well as market and business considerations. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS: Currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree (or higher) from an accredited college or university in Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science or similar field Must graduate December 2027 or later Must continue enrollment in degree program upon completion of the internship Validated academic excellence (3.0 GPA and higher) Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. citizen, U.S. permanent resident, or have asylum or refugee status in the U.S. Honeywell Technologies is currently unable to consider applicants who would require current or future sponsorship for employment authorization for this position. Candidates must be authorized to legally work in the United States without current or future sponsorship requirements. WE VALUE: Embedded systems development using C/C++, ADA, or similar language Knowledge of software configuration management Experience/knowledge of Matlab, Simulink, LabView, Python Interning at Honeywell Technologies provides hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies, professional development, and mentorship within a global organization. Interns will receive relocation benefits and short-term housing if they are 50 miles or more from their assigned work location (excluding Puerto Rico and Canada). The application period for the intern position is estimated to be through the end of March 2027; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. #HoneywellURNAM

jobs.title: SEMN Summer Student Nurse Internship - SNI
jobs.location: Cannon Falls, MN, United States
jobs.body: Student Nurse Intern positions are available in Cannon Falls, Lake City and Red Wing. Interns may have the opportunity to rotate through multiple departments and locations, providing a diverse and well-rounded healthcare experience. More information will be provided at the time of offer. The Student Nurse Intern (SNI) performs delegated tasks of direct and indirect patient care with the supervision of a registered nurse (RN). The designated tasks are those which have been taught in the academic programs and/or orientation, and where the individual has demonstrated competence to a designated RN. Completion of two semesters in an Associate's in Nursing program, or completion of junior year in a Bachelor's in Nursing program required prior to start. Candidates must be graduating between December 2027 and June 2028. Once accepted into the Summer Nursing Internship program, student interns will be required to enroll in a summer intern course at a university or college in Minnesota for the duration of the internship. Information will be provided to selected candidates upon offer acceptance. Basic Life Support (BLS) certification required from American Red Cross or American Heart Association and must not expire during the internship. Reliable transportation is required. The internship will run for 10 weeks from June 7, 2027, through August 13, 2027. Applicants must be able to complete ten consecutive weeks of employment. The application deadline is December 31, 2026. Offers will begin going out the week of February 1, 2027. During the selection process you may participate in an OnDemand (pre-recorded) interview that you can complete at your convenience. During the OnDemand interview, a question will appear on your screen, and you will have time to consider each question before responding. You will have the opportunity to re-record your answer to each question – Mayo Clinic will only see the final recording. The complete interview will be reviewed by a Mayo Clinic staff member, and you will be notified of next steps. There will be a deadline to complete this interview. If you apply to more than one health system site, you will only need to complete the virtual interview once. Your interview responses will be reviewed for all health system locations to which you have applied. (Does not apply to Rochester). You are expected to provide the following application materials at the time you submit your application. Items cannot be uploaded once you hit the submit button. Do not submit your application unless you have attached all of the documents. Applications will be considered incomplete if all of the following items are not attached to your profile: 1. COVER LETTER 2. RESUME The resume should include degree, anticipated graduation date, and employment history. 3. BASIC LIFE SUPPORT (BLS) CERTIFICATION Applicants must attach proof of completion. We will only accept certificates of course completion from the following providers: American Heart Association (Title: BLS for Healthcare Providers) Red Cross (Title: CPR/AED for Professional Rescuers and Health Care Providers OR BLS for Healthcare Providers) Note: If your card is set to expire during the duration of the internship, you must renew your card prior to the first day of employment. It must remain valid throughout the full duration of the internship.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Simulation Intern
jobs.location: McConnellsburg, Pennsylvania, United States, United States of America
jobs.body: About JLG, an Oshkosh company JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world. Assist the Manufacturing Engineering department in successfully achieving manufacturing goals and contributing to simulation and continuous improvement efforts. The Manufacturing simulation Intern will receive assignments from the Manager of Manufacturing, or an assigned representative, and will be encouraged to contribute ideas and suggestions. YOUR IMPACT Collaborate directly with engineering to build discrete event simulation models aimed at identifying plant bottlenecks, evaluating staging capacities, and testing "what-if" production scenarios. Assist in developing and linking digital twins of manufacturing cells and robotics using tools like FlexSim, Emulate3D, and NVIDIA Omniverse. Analyze cycle times, station configurations, and operator movements to support assembly line balancing and optimize plant throughput. Work with real-time industrial sensor and PLC data to feed live operational inputs into your simulation models and custom Ignition dashboards. Use AutoCAD or similar CAD tools to create and revise 2D/3D plant layout drawings to support simulation setup and material flow planning. Research, test, and champion new digital factory tools and automation technologies to keep our manufacturing facility at the cutting edge. Participate in cross-functional continuous improvement initiatives, time studies, and other engineering projects as assigned. All other duties or projects as assigned. MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS Student working towards a bachelor’s degree in data analytics, Industrial engineering, Manufacturing or mechanical engineering or computer science Cumulative GPA of 3.0 or above. STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS Working towards an advanced degree (MS or Ph.D.) with a research focus or coursework directly related to Digital Twins, Industrial simulation, Controls Engineering, or Robotics. Experience or coursework in developing discrete event simulations, robotics simulations, (FlexSim, Emulate3D, Omniverse, etc.). Strong programming experience in Python (or other languages like C++ or C#), with a strong preference for experience in developing NVIDIA Omniverse Kit applications, extensions, or microservices. Basic understanding of controls engineering, PLC systems, or working with industrial sensor/IoT data. Familiar with lean manufacturing principles, six sigma or industrial process optimization. WORKING CONDITIONS The following represents general working conditions for this role. Specific conditions may vary depending on business needs and individual circumstances. This role combines office-based administrative duties with physical activity in field or production environments. In the office setting, tasks may require extended computer use, sitting, and attending meetings. Field or floor work may involve walking across various terrains or shop floors, standing, moderate lifting (up to 50 pounds), climbing stairs, and exposure to varying temperatures or noise levels. Must be able to shift focus between detailed cognitive work and occasional physical tasks as needed. Reasonable accommodations will be provided for qualified individuals with disabilities to support performance across both office and field responsibilities. WHY JLG, AN OSHKOSH COMPANY? Moving the future forward is our priority and this includes your future. We encourage professional development and champion our employees’ success through various skills and training opportunities. Named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies™ by Ethisphere Institute for six consecutive years, everything we do at Oshkosh is guided by our core values and the ~15k+ team members around the world who embody them. We put people first. We do the right thing. We persevere. Within this range, individual pay is determined by various factors, including the scope and responsibilities of the role, the candidate's experience, education and skills, as well as the equity of pay among team members in similar positions. Beyond offering a competitive total rewards package, we prioritize a people-first culture and offer various opportunities to support team member growth and success. jobs.title: Research Intern (Downstream Processing) - Marlborough, MA
jobs.location: Marlborough, MA, United States of America
jobs.body: We are seeking a motivated and technically skilled intern (PhD level) to support research and development activities in downstream processing of extracellular vesicles (EVs) and viral vectors. The successful candidate will work closely with a multidisciplinary team to optimize and execute purification workflows using tangential flow filtration (TFF) and chromatography-based methods. This internship provides hands-on experience in biologics processing and analytical evaluation, contributing directly to process development for therapeutic nanoparticles. Onsite at our Marlborough, MA site, In the Research Intern role, you will serve as a critical contributor to the development and integration of Sartorius’ emerging technologies for characterization and purification of different types of nanoparticles such as extracellular vesicles and viral vectors. These leading-edge platforms will be utilized in basic research as well as the pharmaceutical and biotechnology industries. What you will accomplish together with us Execute Purification Protocols : Perform purification of EVs and viral vectors using TFF systems (hollow fiber and/or flat sheet) and various chromatography modalities (e.g., ion exchange, size exclusion, affinity). Optimize Unit Operations : Assist in the design and optimization of downstream steps to improve product yield , purity , and scalability . System Operation and Maintenance : Operate and maintain TFF and chromatography systems (e.g., AKTA or equivalent), including set-up, cleaning, and troubleshooting. Sample Handling and Quantification : Prepare and process samples following SOPs. Quantify particles using orthogonal methods such as NTA, qPCR, protein assays, and total RNA analysis. Process Monitoring and Data Recording : Monitor and document key parameters (e.g., transmembrane pressure, flux, recovery) during TFF runs. Maintain detailed lab notebooks and process logs. Analytical Support : Support integration of downstream data with analytical assays (e.g., flow cytometry, SEC-MALS, SDS-PAGE) for process characterization. Collaborative Work : Interact regularly with upstream, analytical, and formulation teams to align on process goals and transfer knowledge. Safety and Compliance : Follow laboratory safety protocols and ensure compliance with quality standards and experimental reproducibility. What will convince us Education: PhD candidate in Bioengineering, or closely related discipline with formal education and experience with extracellular vesicles characterization and purification. Experience: Hands-on experience with TFF systems (lab or pilot scale) for nanoparticle or biologics concentration and diafiltration. Practical knowledge of chromatography techniques such as SEC, IEX, or affinity purification. Familiarity with nanoparticle systems such as EVs, viral vectors (e.g., AAV, lentivirus), or LNPs. Comfortable working in a wet lab environment with complex biological samples. Strong documentation and organizational skills; experience with SOPs and batch records is a plus. Experience with analytical tools (e.g., NTA, BCA, qPCR, HPLC, or SEC-MALS) is highly desirable Identification with our core values: Sustainability, Openness, Enjoyment Compensation is up to $30 hr. Help manage 3D CAD data using a Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) system. Contribute to multiple projects, providing support as needed. Help ensure project milestones and deadlines are met. Strong aesthetic sense and ability to translate 2D sketches into 3D models. Basic understanding of design for manufacturing. Effective communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Self-motivated with a positive attitude and good time management. Ability to work well within a team and balance multiple priorities. The Details: This position will provide you with: A utility role interacting with key members of a Fortune 500 company. A flexible schedule featuring a max of 40 hours. Opportunity for career advancement upon graduation. Competitive compensation and career development opportunities. Industrial Design 3D SURFACING internships are available in the following locations: Valley City, Ohio The base pay range for this position is $22.00- $27.00 per hour. Pay is based on market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. All qualified applicants that apply for Stanley Black & Decker will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, disability or protected veteran status . We Don’t Just Build The World, We Build Innovative Technology Too. Job Description The Embedded hardware Internship provides practical exposure to circuit design, PCB layout, prototyping, and testing for embedded and IoT systems. jobs.body: What you’ll do: Position Overview: Fall 2027 Start Date: Sophomore - $22.15, Junior - $24.92, Senior - $27.69 The Manufacturing Engineer Co-Op is responsible for providing assistance to the commercial products and assemblies (CPA) engineering team to develop solutions for product and manufacturing problems. This position will contribute to the manufacturing product line with involvement from project initiation thru manufacturing launch, plus ongoing developments. This position will work closely with the Engineering Manager, Program Manager, other Manufacturing Engineers and System Architects, Electrical Engineers, Product Line Marketing Manager, and Operations team members, Sourcing and Manufacturing personnel to support and continuously improve the product line. What you’ll do: • Provide assistance to line and staff personnel in order to develop solutions for product and manufacturing problems for a complete line of apparatus. • Assist in training and development of personnel. Assemble, verify, and analyze the results of others, prepare reports and present findings. • Initiate and prepare specifications for products, equipment, tooling, processes, and systems to obtain optimum cost and quality manufacturability. • Implement and utilize strategies to ensure concurrent engineering and design for manufacturing concepts with the design engineering team. • Investigate and develop understanding of new technologies and processes and be able to assess these from a broad perspective in terms of the impact of the total business. • Design, develop, justify, and guide the installation of new engineering concepts, equipment, tooling, processes, and systems through appropriate procedures so that optimum manufacturing cost can be achieved and maintained. • Maintain an understanding of JIT, Lean & Agile Manufacturing, Kaizen, TQM, Poka-Yoke and cPQI. • Participate in project management and engaging with multi-disciplined teams to achieve goals using ProLaunch and other project management tools. • Participate in Voice of the Customer (VOC) product and market requirements research. • Ensure timely completion to project commitment dates. • Other duties, projects as assigned. Qualifications: Basic Qualifications: • Actively enrolled in a bachelor’s degree or master’s degree program in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or Manufacturing Engineering. • Minimum of one internship or co-op experience or an equivalent of 3 months work experience completed at the time of this application. • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc. • Minimum cumulative GPA of 2.8 or higher (please don't round). • Must be willing to relocate to the Sumter, SC site for the co-op. Relocation assistance will be provided for candidates that reside outside a 50-mile radius of Sumter, SC. Preferred Qualifications: • Prior internship experience within a manufacturing environment. • Candidate with Yellow Belt certification. • Understanding of Lean Six Sigma concepts preferred. • Proficiency with Microsoft Office

Strong interpersonal skills with a demonstrated ability to influence and collaborate across functions. Demonstrated leadership through coursework, student organizations, research, athletics, military service, or other extracurricular activities preferred. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power‑efficient and high‑performance solutions for high‑growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity and sustainability. For more information, visit www.gf.com . Internship Program Overview: Our Interns & Co-ops are our entry-level talent pipeline for GF across the globe. Our goal is to provide students with a meaningful work experience that will equip them with the skills to embark on a career in the fast-paced and growing semiconductor industry after graduation. As an intern at GF, you’ll experience one-on-one mentorship, work assignments that prioritize your growth and potential, professional development opportunities, and the chance to network with executives. Summary of Role: GlobalFoundries in Essex, VT is seeking a Building System Engineer intern in Essex, VT. Essential Responsibilities: Operates, monitors and maintains, troubleshoots, repairs and replaces facilities mechanical components and systems such as mechanical equipment, Process Cooling Water systems, and exhaust HVAC systems. Oversees the Building Technician as well as the preventive maintenance program. Develops and implements capital improvement projects, such as construction, remodeling, renovation, improvements and maintenance of Building equipment, including preliminary concept development, detailed engineering design and providing scope of work for bidding. Conducts periodic inspections of work in progress and advises construction supervisors and contractors on plans and specifications. Inspects and maintains existing facilities equipment and prepares reports on the condition, deficiencies observed, designs necessary for repairs and estimated cost of repairs. Perform all activities in a safe and responsible manner and support all Environmental, Health, Safety & Security requirements Work and collaborate with other projects and/or assignments as needed. jobs.body: Graco manufactures and markets premium equipment to move, measure, control, dispense and spray a wide variety of fluid and powder materials. What does that mean? We spray the finish on your vehicle, coatings on your pills, the paint on your house and texture on your walls. Graco is part of your daily life. The Graco Intern Program offers more than just work experience—it’s a chance to make an impact. As an intern, you’ll take on projects that matter to the business, contribute to initiatives that drive progress, and develop skills that prepare you for what’s ahead. Throughout the program, you’ll expand your industry knowledge, collaborate with professionals who are passionate about doing things the right way, and experience a culture that thrives on new ideas and continual growth. You’ll also take part in events designed to support both your learning and personal development. The program concludes with a final presentation where you’ll showcase your achievements and the difference you’ve made. Responsible for the quality of the parts they produce and follow all necessary inspection requirements. Work as a team member to aid all shifts and support co-workers to operate to department expectations. Focus on safety and follow all safety rules and requirements. Perform other duties as assigned. jobs.title: Advanced Quality Engineering Intern - The Toro Company
jobs.location: Bloomington, MN, United States of America
jobs.body: The 2027 Summer Internship Program will run from May 17, 2027, through August 6, 2027. Candidates must be available to start on May 17 and participate through the duration of the program. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of a school/employment or any other visa, regardless of expiration date, now or in the future. Who Are We? The Toro Company (TTC) has delivered market-leading, innovative products and outstanding customer care for more than 100 years. With over 11,000 employees worldwide, TTC is headquartered in Bloomington, Minnesota, USA. Our company designs and manufactures turf maintenance equipment; turf irrigation systems; landscape and lighting products; snow and ice management solutions; agricultural irrigation systems; rental, specialty and underground construction equipment; and residential turf and snow equipment. We market and sell TTC products worldwide through a network of distributors, dealers, mass retailers, hardware retailers, equipment rental center and home centers—as well as online direct to end users. What Will You Do? The Advanced Quality Engineering Intern will partner with the Advanced Quality Engineering Team located at our worldwide headquarters. This position will support product development teams, suppliers, & manufacturing plants on new and existing products. Primary job duties will include assisting in the development & deployment of new product advanced quality plans, processes and systems for the Toro Company. Assist in streamlining Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP) processes, including PPAP management, APQP dashboard development, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) tracking, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with Engineering, Quality & Manufacturing teams to develop product design & manufacturing quality requirements. Engage in the New Product Development (NPD) process. Help collect, analyze, and report quality data to support decision-making and continuous improvements efforts. Assess product conformance by performing product validation audits. Pursue corrective actions with appropriate parties on non-conformances. What Do You Need? To be considered for this role, an individual should meet the following minimal requirements: Actively enrolled in an accredited 4-year engineering program in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, or related degree area. We require interns to be enrolled in an educational program during the duration of the internship program. Must have achieved Junior status (2 years completed), with a graduation date no sooner than December of 2027. Technology background/studies preferred. Ability to work independently and within a collaborative, team-oriented environment. Strong communication, presentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills Proficiency with MS software (Excel, Word, & PowerPoint) We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. What Can We Give You? At The Toro Company, we are always working to make sure our interns know just how valued they are. In addition to a competitive pay- The Toro Company offers interns a variety of perks, including: Dress for your day – We know you're more productive when you're comfortable, which is why TTC employees are encouraged to take advantage of our casual, corporate environment. Volunteerism – The Toro Company is proud to provide interns 8 hours of paid time to volunteer in the community. Summer Hours *Based on Location* – Enjoy a flexible schedule during the summer! By working a little more during the first few days of the week, TTC employees at certain locations are able to start their weekends early and leave by noon on Friday. Competitive Pay – Competitive compensation with an anticipated hourly rate of $22–$28. Actual rates may vary based on factors such as academic standing, business function, and other relevant considerations. The Toro Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider all qualified applicants based on merit and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, or other non-merit factors. We are committed to creating a welcoming environment for all employees.

jobs.title: 2027 Energy Engineering Intern
jobs.location: Nashville, Tennessee, United States of America
jobs.body: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient climate solutions for buildings, homes and transportation, it's our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies , and through our businesses including Trane® and Thermo King , sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what's possible for a sustainable world. Learn about our benefits designed for you to Thrive at work and at home. We boldly go. Where is the work: On-Site (5 days) What’s in it for you: Be a part of our mission! As a world leader in creating comfortable, sustainable, and efficient environments, it’s our responsibility to put the planet first. For us at Trane Technologies, sustainability is not just how we do business—it is our business. Do you dare to look at the world's challenges and see impactful possibilities? Do you want to contribute to making a better future? If the answer is yes, we invite you to consider joining us in boldly challenging what’s possible for a sustainable world. This is an exciting opportunity to make a difference in building efficiency and sustainability through our Equipment, Service or Controls / Building Automation offerings. Trane Technologies, the global leader in innovative climate solutions, hands on summer internship allows participants to explore a career in Energy Engineering through the following: A 12-week Summer internship program that will challenge and develop your technical, business, leadership, and communication skills. Gain insight into an Energy Engineering Career with Trane Technologies, focusing on solutions that provide our customers with the most energy-efficient buildings. Work on a variety of engineering aspects, including energy analysis projects, completion of field energy audits, client interviews, completion of estimates, and development of energy conversation measures, and project management. This internship will provide you with the experience to pursue a career in Energy Engineering and creates the opportunity to join our industry leading Graduate Training Program (GTP) after graduation. What you will do: Our internship program provides you with the opportunity to learn more about us while you collaborate with peers across North America. As an Energy Engineer Intern, you may experience and assist in: Partnering with Account Managers and Energy Engineers to diagnose energy opportunities with customer’s facilities and provide small energy projects that solve customer issues/opportunities. Providing technical analysis/review for energy projects; providing project risk assessment. Shadowing and performing building “walk-throughs” and identifying energy conservation measures (architectural, mechanical, electrical, etc.) in commercial, institutional, and industrial facilities. Collaborating on the development of existing reporting capabilities from a software standpoint and a usability perspective and investigate new technologies. Prescribing best methods for measurement and verification of system performance during the acquisition phase. Analyzing data outputs for trends and/or any deviations that need further investigating. Assisting with opportunity technical qualification including Preliminary Audits, Benchmarking, Site Surveys, and Interviews. Collecting, analyzing, and developing benchmark summary reports to illustrate the pertinent details of building and/or system performance. What you will bring: Actively enrolled in a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Engineering, (preferred disciplines: Energy, Mechanical or Electrical) throughout the entire duration of the summer internship. Candidates must have completed at least their sophomore or 2nd year before the start of the summer internship to be eligible for internship positions. Be a U.S. citizen or have the legal right to work in the U.S. without requiring sponsorship now or in the future. This posting is for multiple opportunities. Some positions may be remote while others may require a hybrid or onsite assignment at one of our facilities across North America. Possess a valid driver’s license for a minimum of 12 months, ability to provide proof of insurance, and have no major or frequent traffic violations including, but not limited to: DUI in the previous 3 years Hit & Run, License Suspension, Reckless / Careless Driving or multiple smaller infractions or preventable collisions in the previous 3 years. This role has been designated by the Company as Safety Sensitive. Annual Base Salary Range or Hourly Base Pay Range: $22.50 - $31.00 Compensation Type: Hourly Incentive Eligible: No Sales Commission Eligible: No Disclaimer : We strive to provide competitive compensation for this position, tailored to a variety of factors. The actual compensation will depend on elements such as seniority, merit, geographic location, education, experience, travel requirements, and union designation. Our compensation range is generally based on the national average for the country. Additionally, benefits may vary depending on the region, business alignment, union involvement, and employee status. Thrive at work and at home: Benefits kick in on DAY ONE for you and your family, including health insurance and holistic wellness programs that include generous incentives – WE DARE TO CARE! Family building benefits include fertility coverage and adoption/surrogacy assistance. Paid time off includes up to 15 vacation days, paid holidays, sick leave, and additional options to support volunteer and parental leave. 401K match up, educational and training opportunities through company programs along with tuition assistance and student debt support. Disclaimer: Benefit offerings may vary by site as well as Collective Bargaining Agreements and local/state regulations Safety Sensitive Role: No The company designates certain roles as Safety Sensitive. Safety Sensitive roles may require that you pass additional drug screening. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits and programs. jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship
jobs.location: Houston, TX
jobs.body: Build relationships. Be part of history. Have an impact… We are a hypersonic transportation company focused on doing what people once thought was impossible. And, we have a place for you if you want to be part of hypersonic history. We're looking for intern candidates with relevant academic, project, research, or hands-on experience in one or more of the following disciplines: Propulsion Systems Engineering Structures Engineering (Vehicle Engineering & Design) Manufacturing Engineering Software Engineering Test Operations Brands & Communications Business Strategy & Operations As an intern, you will work closely with your mentor, experienced engineers, and other teammates who will help you apply your knowledge and grow your skills on projects that have a significant impact. What You Have: Must be able to meet U.S. Government space technology regulations, including ITAR. Ability to be onsite with us in Houston, TX. Cumulative GPA of 3.3 or higher on a 4.0 scale Currently enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate program and have at least one semester of school remaining after the internship. Available to work full time for a minimum of 11 weeks and start in either May or June. Strong written, verbal, communication, and interpersonal skills – we work in a highly collaborative environment. Aerospace experience is not required - we are looking for smart, motivated, collaborative engineers who enjoy solving tough problems and want to make an impact in hypersonic travel. Must be at least a rising junior (entering the third year of undergraduate study) by the start of the summer internship program. What Will Set You Apart: Relevant engineering internship/co-op and academic project experience that demonstrate development of both technical skills as well as leadership qualities. Relevant academic, hands-on project experience. Passion for hypersonic travel. Even if you have skill sets and experience that are outside of our current needs, we encourage you to apply. If you’ve demonstrated a commitment to academic success and motivation to apply your knowledge outside of the classroom, we may have a future opportunity for you! Salary will be within the range of $26/hour to $30/hour and based on current class standing and program i.e. junior, senior, undergraduate, master's, etc.

jobs.title: Summer Intern - Setpoint and Control Systems
jobs.body: > Are you interested in being part of an innovative team that supports Westinghouse's mission to provide clean energy solutions? At Westinghouse, we recognize that our employees are our most valuable asset and we seek to identify, attract and recruit the most qualified talent while recognizing and encouraging the value of diversity in the global workplace. You will report to the Setpoint and Control Systems Manager and be located at our Warrendale and Cranberry facilities. This is a paid full-time hybrid position for the summer, May - August 2027. jobs.body: > Job Title: Production Planning Intern Job ID: 41261 Job Location: Rochester, NY Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked, and have every other Friday off Job Description: As an intern in the production planning role, you will assist in planning, scheduling, and monitoring manufacturing status and approval of products through the entire production cycle to meet production, and ultimately customer, requirements. You will work from engineering plans and production specifications to ensure timely provision of materials. Additionally, you will advise management on the status of work in progress, coordinate with manufacturing, quality, and supply chain teams, and interface with engineering, program management, and external customers. Your responsibilities will include ensuring the availability of materials and labor to meet production needs and delivery commitments, as well as resolving labor and material shortages, backlogs, and other potential schedule interruptions. Essential Functions: Develop and implement manufacturing build plans to meet customer contractual delivery schedules Utilize Materials Requirement Planning (MRP) system to input Master Schedule build plans, track material availability, status kit readiness, release shop orders, and maintain all shop order records and inventory integrity Update and maintain make items lead times within MRP system Manage floor stock of program components Work jointly with Manufacturing and Quality teams to execute build schedule and address any issues in a timely manner Work with Materials Planners to proactively manage the schedule and material dock dates to ensure accuracy of planning Provide hardware status, updates and performance statistics to program team based on status of hardware through Manufacturing Execution System (MES) Some things to include if needed / depending on the role: Travel requirements with an estimated % or quantitative amount Valid Driver’s License Ability to complete physical tasks Ability to obtain a US Security Clearance (if not required on day 1) Qualifications: To be eligible, applicants must be pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in supply chain management, Logistics Management, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Administration or related field or have completed their bachelor’s degree within the last 12 months, regardless of age. Preferred Additional Skills: Knowledge and/or experience in scheduling or supply chain planning preferred. Strong computer and analytical skills combined with the ability to manage large amounts of quantitative data Proficient in the use Microsoft Office software; working knowledge of relational data bases.
